responsibility: Generated GCC option description file for the LoongArch target. It is the instantiated form of loongarch.opt.in, containing the actual enum values, variables, and option records for LoongArch machine options that GCC’s option parser uses to create la_opt_* state and target masks consumed later by loongarch-opts.cc and driver specs.
same_name_distinction: For the loongarch same-name set, this generated .opt file defines the LoongArch command-line option records, enums, and option variables used by GCC's option parser. Unlike loongarch.cc, loongarch.h, and loongarch.md, it is option-description metadata rather than backend implementation code, target macro definitions, or instruction-pattern descriptions.
